places.name: Old Town (Altstadt)
places.ai_summary: A charming historic area with cobblestone streets, medieval buildings, and vibrant cafes and shops.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and cafes have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the hidden alleys for unique finds.

places.name: Lake Zurich Promenade
places.ai_summary: A scenic lakeside walkway perfect for relaxing strolls, picnics, and enjoying the view of the Alps.
places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the serene atmosphere.

places.name: Bahnhofstrasse
places.ai_summary: One of the world's most exclusive shopping avenues, featuring luxury boutiques, department stores, and cafes.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the side streets for more shopping and dining options.

places.name: Grossmünster
places.ai_summary: A landmark church with twin towers, offering panoramic views of the city from the tower's top.
places.place_tip: Climb the tower for the best views of Zurich.

places.name: Fraumünster & Chagall Windows
places.ai_summary: Famous for its stunning stained-glass windows by Marc Chagall, this church is a masterpiece of Gothic architecture.
places.place_tip: Visit during a choir performance for a magical experience.

places.name: Uetliberg Mountain Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: The best panoramic view of Zurich and the Lake Zurich, especially stunning at sunrise and sunset.
places.place_tip: Bring a camera and some snacks.

places.name: Lindenhof Hill
places.ai_summary: A historic site and park offering great views of the city, the river, and the university.

opening_hours.notes: A peaceful spot in the city.

places.place_tip: Great spot for a quiet read or a picnic.

places.name: Swiss National Museum
places.ai_summary: Switzerland's most important cultural history museum, housed in a fairytale castle.
places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique souvenirs.

places.name: Kunsthaus Zürich
places.ai_summary: The principal art museum in Zurich, featuring works from the Middle Ages to contemporary art.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the modern art section.

places.name: Zurich Opera House
places.ai_summary: A renowned opera house offering a rich program of opera, ballet, and concerts.
places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular shows.

places.name: Botanical Garden (University of Zurich)
places.ai_summary: A beautiful and tranquil garden with a vast collection of plants from around the world.
places.place_tip: Visit the tropical greenhouse.

places.name: Sechseläutenplatz
places.ai_summary: A large public square known for the Sechseläuten festival, with the famous 'Böögg' snowman.
places.place_tip: Join the locals for a picnic during the festival.

places.ai_summary: A viewpoint terrace at ETH Zurich offering stunning views of the city and the Alps.
places.place_tip: Visit the ETH Zurich campus for more interesting architecture.

places.name: Viadukt & Markthalle
places.ai_summary: A unique shopping and dining destination built into the arches of a railway viaduct.

opening_hours.notes: Check market days for special events.

places.place_tip: Try the local delicacies at the market hall.

places.name: Chinagarten Zürich
places.ai_summary: A peaceful Chinese garden with traditional architecture, plants, and a pond.
places.place_tip: Participate in a tea ceremony if available.

places.name: Rietberg Museum
places.ai_summary: An art museum set in a beautiful park, focusing on non-European art and artifacts.
places.place_tip: Explore the museum's beautiful gardens.

places.name: Sihlcity & Sihl Promenade
places.ai_summary: A modern shopping and leisure complex by the river, with a cinema, shops, and restaurants.

opening_hours.notes: Check individual store and restaurant hours.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a movie at the cinema followed by dinner.

places.name: Bürkliplatz & Boat Pier
places.ai_summary: A picturesque square by the lake with a boat pier, offering lake cruises and beautiful views.
places.place_tip: Take a boat cruise on Lake Zurich.

places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the Swiss architect Le Corbusier, showcasing his work and design philosophy.
places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a walk in the surrounding park.

places.name: Zoo Zürich & Masoala Rainforest
places.ai_summary: A renowned zoo with a wide variety of animals and the immersive Masoala Rainforest exhibit.

opening_hours.notes: Masoala Rainforest exhibit has separate entry.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking.
